about_short_description.short_description: Clio provides cloud-based legal practice management software, helping law firms manage cases, billing, and client relationships.

product.name: Clio Manage
product.description: Cloud-based legal practice management software for organizing matters, contacts, documents, deadlines, time, billing, payments, and firm operations.

product.name: Clio Work
product.description: An AI-powered legal workspace that uses matter context and legal authorities to support research, case analysis, strategy development, document review, and drafting.

product.name: Clio Grow
product.description: Client intake and legal CRM software for capturing leads, managing consultations, collecting information, generating documents, and converting prospects into clients.

product.name: Clio Draft
product.description: AI-enabled legal document automation software for creating reusable templates, completing document sets, using court forms, collecting information, and obtaining signatures.

product.name: Clio Accounting
product.description: Legal accounting software for managing law-firm financial transactions, trust accounting, reconciliations, and financial records within the Clio platform.

product.name: Clio for Clients
product.description: A secure client-facing portal for sharing documents and case information, receiving updates, communicating with legal teams, and supporting client collaboration.
